ruleDefinitions.name: Tap Installer Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Well-known TAP software installation. Possible preparation for data exfiltration using tunneling techniques

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\tapinstall\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Avast\\ Software\\\\SecureLine\\ VPN\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Avast\\ Software\\\\SecureLine\\ VPN\\\\.*")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\OpenVPN\\ Connect\\\\drivers\\\\tap\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Proton\\ Technologies\\\\ProtonVPNTap\\\\installer\\\\.*"))
